[b] Pantagrueli Department of Foreign Affairs
[/b]
[i]To the esteemed republic of [nation=noflag]Astanir[/nation],

The Iron Realm offers Astanir a lump sum of [u]1.2 billion dollars[/u] in exchange for the islands to the southeast. If accepted, this agreement will create a strong foundation for closer relations between Astanir and Pantagruel. Pantagruel will also provide major discounts on exports of oil, natural gas, and phosphorus to Astanir. As the only nation forming economic ties with Pantagruel through this deal, [u]Astanir will receive exclusive access to resources worth trillions[/u], ensuring long-term mutual growth and cooperation. In addition,  Pantagruel is also interested in importing military equipment from Astanir, such as aircraft, seacraft, and missile projection systems.[u] Pantagruel is willing to invest 3B$ dollars into the Astanirian defence stock market[/u], including shares in both defence suppliers and nation-wide programs. 

We wish this message sees you well, and that you are able to see the potential gain from accepting such a deal. [/i][/quote]

[i][b]Reply from: Astaniran military council, general Ikaia Alonir[/b][/i]

The military union of Astanir is pleased to accept your offer for our southern territories, in exchange for 1.2 billion dollars (6.5 billion Sani) and access to discounted oil, gas and phosphorus imports.

We will also be happy to export our variety of naval vessels and our abundance of small arms to Pantagruel.

Therefore, [u]we accept your deal[/u]
